title: 1906 Land Deed – Addie L. Webster and Lazarus Benjamin Wilson
location: Deals Island, Somerset County, Maryland, United States
description: Deed dated August 20, 1906, in which Lazarus B. Wilson and his wife, Annie B. Wilson, of Baltimore City, Maryland, conveyed a parcel of land on Deals Island in Somerset County, Maryland, to Mrs. Addie L. Webster for $250. The property was described as part of a five-acre parcel formerly belonging to William Evans and land formerly belonging to Joseph Beauchamp. According to the Wilson-Daniel family tree, the grantor was Lazarus Benjamin Wilson (1857–1922), the maternal uncle of Addie Leola Daniel Webster (1881–1922). Lazarus and Addie's mother, Mary Catherine Wilson (1859–1910), were children of Samuel David Wilson (1823–1914). The deed documents a property transaction between Lazarus and Addie, while the family relationship is identified through genealogical research and awaits independent corroboration.

Lines 20–22 record the immediately following household, headed by Snead Webster (age 58), with his sons Charles Webster (age 21) and Wilson Webster (age 10). description: The Twelfth Census of the United States, enumerated June 21, 1900, records James F. Daniel (age 45) and his wife Mary C. Daniel (age 40) in Tangier District, Somerset County, Maryland, Enumeration District 81, sheet 22. Their household, appearing on lines 13–19, includes five children: Isadora F. Daniel (age 19), Kittie W. Daniel (age 16), James F. Daniel (age 14), Annie W. Daniel (age 12), and Wilson B. Daniel (age 2). Their daughter Addie Leola Daniel Webster was already married and appears with her husband Snead Webster in a separate household in the 1900 census.

title: 1899 Marriage License Application – Snead Webster and Addie Daniel
description: Application for a marriage license submitted to the Clerk of the Circuit Court for Somerset County, Maryland, on December 23, 1899. The document identifies the prospective groom as Snead Webster, age 27, and the prospective bride as Addie Daniel, age 18. Both were recorded as single, white, and residents of Somerset County, Maryland. The application was made under oath by W. O. Brown before Clerk Albin T. Beauchamp. This record documents their intention to marry but does not independently establish the date on which the marriage ceremony occurred.

title: 1900 Property Deed – Snead Webster and Webster Family
location: Deals Island, Somerset County, Maryland, United States
description: Property deed dated October 5, 1900, involving Noah W. Webster and his wife Rose A. Webster, and John F. Webster and his wife Lucy B. Webster, of Baltimore City, Maryland. The deed records a conveyance to Snead Webster of Deals Island, Somerset County, Maryland, for a consideration of $115. The property is described as a lot or parcel of land situated on Deals Island, Somerset County, Maryland. The deed provides evidence of Snead Webster's involvement in property ownership on Deals Island and identifies other Webster family members participating in the transaction. Their precise relationships to Snead require separate verification.
